definitions.downstream_es_*: retained 64-sample R0 trajectory energy score; P2=G and P3=HTC
definitions.eq90_threshold_*: empirical 0.90 quantile of per-row XY squared standardized residual on the identical condition/seed rows
definitions.eq90_volume_g: XY ellipse area in m^2 at empirical 90% coverage; legacy field name retained
definitions.eq90_volume_htc: XY ellipse area in m^2 at empirical 90% coverage; legacy field name retained
definitions.linear90_inside_g: natural uncalibrated 90% inclusion for the complete 8-D linear state using chi-square(df=8)
definitions.linear90_inside_htc: natural uncalibrated 90% inclusion for the complete 8-D linear state using 8*F(df1=8,df2=nu)
definitions.xy_nll_g: uncalibrated 2-D diagonal Gaussian XY NLL from the frozen G/M1 head
definitions.xy_nll_htc: uncalibrated 2-D multivariate Student-t XY NLL from the frozen HTC/M2 head

downstream_contract: existing frozen CV/MLP, 64 samples, shared process-noise draws, and common random numbers; no replay or retraining
upstream_calibration: none for NLL and natural coverage; empirical rescaling is used only to define the equal-coverage sharpness diagnostic
